editorial_thesis: The strongest current signal is operational: expanded agent capacity must be paired with visible runtime boundaries, accountable work intake, and narrowly consented context.

topic_groups.title: Bounded Execution + Artifact Access
topic_groups.selection_rationale: This is a deliberately narrow operational lane: recent coverage examined agent authority, while these releases expose the runtime, time, and stored-output boundaries an operator must now govern.

sources.title: Workflow steps now support extended function durations
sources.why_selected: Vercel Pro and Enterprise workflow steps can run up to 30 minutes, up from 800 seconds, after enabling an environment flag; Hobby remains capped at five minutes.
sources.usefulness: Use it for one bounded, resumable client task such as a site audit or media transformation, with an explicit timeout and output contract.

sources.title: Connect to and manage Sandboxes from the dashboard
sources.why_selected: The dashboard can now open a terminal into a running Sandbox, browse files, transfer files, inspect ports, snapshot, stop, and resume persistent sandboxes.
sources.usefulness: Add an operator inspection step for agent runs that produce deployable files or need incident triage.

sources.title: Vercel WAF for Blob is now in beta
sources.why_selected: Vercel can apply deny, challenge, rate-limit, redirect, and log rules at the edge for Blob stores without changing blob URLs or application code.
sources.usefulness: Protect client downloads, generated reports, and expensive media endpoints before transfer occurs.

topic_groups.title: Delegated Work Intake
topic_groups.selection_rationale: This fills a coverage gap between agent capability and portfolio coordination: the fresh signal is not another coding model, but a clearer handoff from a work item to a supervised draft PR.

sources.title: Copilot cloud agent for Linear is now generally available
sources.why_selected: GitHub Copilot cloud agent can be assigned from Linear to work asynchronously in an ephemeral GitHub Actions environment, update the issue timeline, and open a draft pull request.
sources.usefulness: Pilot a low-risk maintenance issue where the acceptance criteria and repository are unambiguous.

sources.title: AI Agents — Linear Docs
sources.why_selected: Linear keeps the human as primary assignee when work is delegated, supports team-scoped agent access, and records guidance with full history.
sources.usefulness: Use workspace guidance for universal delivery rules and team guidance for repository, review, and client conventions.

sources.title: Multi-select fields for Projects and Issues in public preview
sources.why_selected: GitHub Projects and Issue fields can now hold multiple values, enabling one item to be tagged by several teams, modules, or work categories.
sources.usefulness: Model client impact, workstream, risk, and agent eligibility without forcing a single category.

topic_groups.title: Consented Personal Context
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A personal-leverage lane earns inclusion because a new consumer health connector makes selective, revocable context a concrete product pattern—not merely a privacy principle.

sources.title: Launching Health in ChatGPT
sources.why_selected: OpenAI is rolling out Health in ChatGPT to logged-in U.S. adults on web and iOS, with permissioned connections to Apple Health and supported medical records.
sources.usefulness: For personal use, turn a complex appointment or lab-result review into a question-preparation workflow while retaining the source record and clinician as authority.

sources.title: View health records in Health on iPhone
sources.why_selected: Apple Health downloads records from participating providers to iPhone; sharing can be category-specific and limited to current records rather than future updates.
sources.usefulness: Use the current-versus-future sharing distinction as a design cue for client consent flows involving sensitive data.

sources.title: Health and fitness apps — Apple Developer
sources.why_selected: Apple describes HealthKit as a permissioned repository and asks apps to clearly explain intended use when requesting health, motion, or location data.
sources.usefulness: Apply the same request-by-request explanation to Buildn prototypes that handle identity, financial, or customer-sensitive context.
